descriptions.1070286102996554: Associate Wiring Design and Installation Engineer Company: The Boeing Company Our Boeing Commercial Airlines (BCA), SWI (Seat Wire Integration) Electrical Design organization  has an exciting opportunity for an Associate Wiring Design and Installation Engineer  (Level 2) in  North Charleston, South Carolina to help us define the future of commercial aerospace with innovative ideas that advance our culture of safety and quality that our customers, the flying public, expect.  Position Responsibilities:  This role will focus heavily on 787 seats and interiors. Travel to other SpaceX factories to transfer working production programs and fixtures as needed. Hands-on in-circuit test (ICT / Teradyne or equivalent) and/or flying probe: programs, fixtures, and debug.
